tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the live catalog of Gameshop Enter — original retro Nintendo games, consoles, PlayStation 4/5 games and Pokémon TCG, all personally tested, shipping to all 27 EU countries plus Monaco. Understands abbreviations ("gba"), Dutch and English game names, typos, and Pokémon version names in German,

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Fetch current price, stock and details for one Gameshop Enter product by its SKU (as returned by search_products). Includes the product-page URL (url) and a direct checkout link (checkoutUrl) that puts the item in the cart and opens checkout.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Answer "what does this cost in total, delivered?" — items, the exact checkout shipping tier, any running promotion and the total in EUR, for any of the 27 EU countries. Pass the same SKU twice for quantity 2. Includes a checkoutUrl.

tools.name: store_info
tools.description: Shipping costs and delivery times per EU country, free-shipping thresholds, 30-day return policy, payment methods and languages of Gameshop Enter.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_products" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
